listings.remarks: This adorable single-story home is the one for you! Nestled in a desirable golf-course corner lot, this gem offers 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and a 2-car garage. Inside, you'll discover sizable living areas perfect for entertaining and relaxation, including a formal dining room. The kitchen comes equipped with ample counters, plenty of cabinet space, essential appliances, and a pantry. The main bedroom hosts a walk-in closet for easy organization and a full bathroom for added comfort. The backyard includes a covered patio ideal for enjoying a refreshing drink. Hurry up and check it out!
highlights: Single story on a golf-course corner lot
2-car garage with cabinets and golf cart garage
Sun City amenities: pool, rec center, golf

listings.remarks: FULLY FURNISHED DESIGNER SHOWSTOPPER--JUST BRING YOUR TOOTHBRUSH! This stunning 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath home offers luxury, style, and effortless living. Professionally furnished by an interior designer and extensively upgraded throughout, this home impresses from the moment you arrive. A beautiful paver driveway and inviting covered front patio welcome you into an open-concept floor plan featuring soaring vaulted ceilings, designer lighting, upgraded flooring and carpeting, and gorgeous cabinetry extending to the ceiling. The main-level primary suite offers an oversized shower and separate soaking tub, while the spacious upstairs loft provides versatile additional living space. Dual-pane windows and a tankless water heater add modern convenience. Designed for entertaining, the stunning backyard features a covered patio with tile flooring that matches the interior, creating a seamless indoor-outdoor feel, along with two beautiful fire features. THE ULTIMATE BONUS? This is the only home with a private backyard gate offering direct access to the community pool area! Enjoy resort-style convenience just steps from your backyard. Beautifully furnished, thoughtfully upgraded, and move-in ready. Everything is done--all that's missing is you!
highlights: Sold fully furnished by an interior designer
Main-level primary suite with soaking tub
Private backyard gate to the community pool

listings.remarks: TWO PRIMARY SUITES WITH SEPARATE ENTRANCES, NEARLY HALF AN ACRE & NO HOA! This 4-bedroom, 3-bath home sits on a spacious corner lot offering privacy, versatility, and room to spread out. Ideal for multigenerational living or guests, the dual primary suites provide flexible living options. The tri-level, open-concept floor plan features classic wood flooring, a striking wraparound fireplace, French doors, and a charming entryway with brick flower shelving. The gourmet kitchen boasts granite countertops and a stone tile backsplash. Additional highlights include stone tile showers, a spacious laundry room, and a large wet bar perfect for entertaining or a game room. Outside, enjoy mature palm trees, an expansive backyard, and an oversized covered patio.
highlights: Two primary suites, one with a separate entrance
Nearly half an acre on a corner lot
RV access, circular drive and detached workshop
Solar panels and tankless water heater
